self_check_policy.note_zh: 本文件记录本包在提交前完成的自检。每项给出检查对象、结论与复核方式。凡涉及临时几何、缺失控制条件或无法核验数据的内容，均以 unknown 或 pass 附说明的方式如实记录，不以 pass 掩盖缺口。
self_check_policy.note_en: This file records the self-checks completed before submission. Each entry names its target, conclusion, and verification method. Provisional geometry, missing controls, and unverifiable data are recorded honestly as unknown, or as pass with an explicit caveat, never masked.
